source: Open items from the Q4 Playbook (Sep 24), the Sep 25 PROMETRA meeting, the project board (Sep 26-27), the ad docs, and the METO app review (Sep 27).

items.title: Approve the monthly boost caps
items.detail: $100 a month on the METO Movement account and $100 on @dromavi. For movement pieces that is $500 planned from Sep 28 to Dec 31, plus one optional $50 boost in November. Every boost still has to earn 10 MOVEMENT comments in 48 hours first.

items.title: Decide who presses Boost
items.detail: Dr. Omavi can boost from his own ad account when our Friday report says a post earned its 10 MOVEMENT comments. Or Venelt runs Ads Manager with a card and the caps in writing.

items.title: Boosts on @prometrausa: $0, or targeted ads?
items.detail: The Q4 plan gives @prometrausa $0. The Sep 25 meeting said PROMETRA-only posts should get targeted ads and boosts there. Eight PROMETRA scripts are now written, so this needs one answer.

items.title: Where should Instagram send people?
items.detail: Every call to action names metomovement.com, but its sign-up still hands off to the old Teachable course. The new METO app is live but not linked from the site, and Venelt has no access to the domain settings.

items.title: Yes or no on three pieces waiting on you
items.detail: How to Draw the Star (filming Oct 5 only with a yes), the DNA piece 'Where I'm From', and 'fifty people' as the way to describe the group.

items.title: Should the photo ads and scripted video ads run at all?
items.detail: Seven photo ads and 25 written video ad scripts exist, but the Q4 plan only funds $50 boosts inside the caps. If they run, they need real photos, a tracking pixel, audiences and a separate budget.

items.title: Read access to Instagram Insights for all three accounts
items.detail: Meta Business Suite access for @prometrausa, the METO Movement account and @dromavi. Until then, the views, watch time and follower slides show only clearly labeled sample numbers.

items.title: Turn on the MOVEMENT auto-reply
items.detail: The ManyChat reply that sends the course link is off, so comments are answered by hand. The METO account gets no boosts until it is confirmed working.

items.title: The METO Movement account's handle
items.detail: It is not written down anywhere yet. We need it to track the account and to build the ad audiences.

items.title: Friday counts: sign-ups, applications and seats
items.detail: Curriculum sign-ups, pilgrimage applications and confirmed seats. One message every Friday is enough.

items.title: Can people still get a seat after Oct 1 and Oct 20?
items.detail: The pilgrimage, objection and deadline ads keep inviting applications. They can only run if there is still a path to a seat after airfare and the airline list.

items.title: 12 modules or 13?
items.detail: The site, the photo ads and the weekly session plan say 12. The app has 13 module films. Ads and captions will use the number you confirm.

items.title: The campus list for the ambassador boost
items.detail: The Oct 19 ambassador reel boost targets El Paso plus the campuses you name.

items.title: Meta's advertiser check for social-issue ads
items.detail: Meta treats heritage content as a social issue, so the ad account has to pass this check before any METO ad runs.

items.title: Sign off the 13 module films
items.detail: All 13 are live in the app as drafts. Facilitators need about two weeks to review before sessions start in mid-October.

items.title: Sign off the 15 shorts and the flagged ad scripts
items.detail: Short 01 is cut and ready for a yes to post, and the 15 Shorts have seven open questions for Nehanda. Eleven ad scripts need a check on facts, faith wording or companions before they can be filmed.
